expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no operative parameter change is supported by the supplied evidence.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A without a supplied contrast for delta=0.5 or 2.0 would be an unbacked curvature change; the executing scalar's only curvature is pointcloud_delta_A (default 1 A).
Selecting a region_index or temporal_region_index from pair-kernel/moment diagnostics would treat a diagnostic feature as a force the pointcloud formula does not contain.
Changing teacher_neighbors would alter a static teacher mixture whose temperatures are immutable and whose score correlations are observational only.
Using temporal_teacher_blend would inject observed-teacher coordinates whose temporal contrasts are unvalidated (extrapolation disallowed, many sign changes).
Any survival- or turnover-based edit would misread recorded joint-head credit and accounting residuals as decoded terminal affinity benefit.
rationale: Retain the incumbent; no registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-first objective. (1) The Analyst's strongest reproducible endpoint contrasts are pair_kernel_1.5-3.5 and landmark_00_occupancy3 (endpoint_effects:9-11,15), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no allowed edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express that observable; treating it as an independent force would be unsupported. (2) The only operative curvature is pointcloud_delta_A, fixed at 1.0 A in the incumbent; the supplied evidence gives no contrast for delta=0.5 or 2.0, so changing it would be an unbacked guess rather than an evidence-driven edit. (3) Region and temporal-region edits would require a validated salience direction, but every supplied continuous contrast is an observed-node linear interpolation with extrapolation_allowed=false, polynomial_accepted=false, many sign changes and strong sign conflicts (continuous:0-9, continuous_functions), and curve fidelity is weak (relative_node_RMSE ~0.29-0.93; curve_support), so no constant or time-conditioned regional rule is validated. (4) Teacher-neighbor edits are not supported: teacher modes are static with temperature_edits=false and fixed mixture_temperature 0.5 / teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 (teacher_modes, fixed_parameters), and the audit reports only observational teacher-score correlations (information_audit). (5) Temporal_teacher_blend would mix in observed-teacher coordinates, but the temporal evidence is unvalidated and the joint diagnostics show selection innovation negatively associated with observed_child_score_gain (joint_diagnostics:2), a counterexample against treating larger innovation as favorable. (6) Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false; lineage_support), and no survival effect survives BH correction, so no survival-based edit is defensible. Retaining the incumbent is the valid choice; the decision would change only if a registered edit were tied to a validated contrast for the executing pointcloud scalar (e.g. a supported pointcloud_delta_A contrast) or to a validated regional/temporal salience direction.
